modules.title: 同一批访客怎样随机进入 A、B 两版并产生可比较结果
A/B 测试需要哪些基本条件

items.title: 一次实验只回答一个主要问题
items.text: 先写清改变什么、预期影响哪个主要指标，避免同时修改多处后无法解释结果来自哪里。

items.title: 同期随机分组并保持口径一致
items.text: 符合条件的用户随机进入各版本，两组的目标人群、事件定义和时间范围需要一致。

items.title: 提前约定怎样判断和停止
items.text: 主要指标、保护指标、样本需求和停止规则在开始前确定；统计显著也不自动代表业务影响足够大。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: {c:ab-test} 用随机对照比较版本带来的差异；普通前后对比只能看到变化，不能排除同时发生的其他因素。{c:feature-flag} 可以控制谁看到某个版本，但功能开关本身不等于实验设计。

lessonPractice.title: 团队想比较两种注册引导。下面哪种做法最接近有效的 A/B 测试？

options.label: 同一时期把符合条件的新访客随机分到 A、B 两版，预先确定注册完成率和错误率，再按约定样本与时间分析
options.feedback: 对。同期随机分组减少了流量和时间差异，预设主要指标、保护指标和停止条件也避免根据中途波动挑结果。

options.label: 本月给所有人上线 B 版，再与上月 A 版比较
options.feedback: 流量来源、活动和季节都可能变化，前后差异不能只归因于页面版本。

options.label: 实验开始后每小时查看，哪一版暂时领先就立刻停止并宣布胜出
options.feedback: 短期随机波动可能制造领先。应在开始前约定分析窗口和停止规则。

en.title: Which approach is closest to a valid A/B test for two sign-up guides?

options.label: During the same period, randomly assign eligible new visitors to A or B, predefine completion and error rates, and analyze after the agreed sample and duration
options.feedback: Correct. Concurrent random assignment reduces traffic and time differences, while predefined metrics and stopping rules limit result picking.

options.label: Show B to everyone this month and compare it with A from last month
options.feedback: Traffic sources, campaigns, and seasonality may change, so the difference cannot be attributed only to the page.

options.label: Check hourly and stop as soon as one version briefly leads
options.feedback: Short-term random variation can create a temporary lead. Set the analysis window and stopping rule before launch.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为这两版注册引导整理 A/B 测试方案，先写清单一假设、参与条件、随机分流方式、主要指标、保护指标、分析时间和停止规则。检查埋点能否对两组使用同一口径。只生成方案和验证清单，不要自动启动实验、修改流量或把暂时领先写成胜出；统计判断需要数据人员确认。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Draft an A/B test plan for these two sign-up guides. State one hypothesis, eligibility, random assignment, the primary metric, guardrail metrics, analysis window, and stopping rule. Check that both groups use the same tracking definitions. Produce the plan and verification checklist only: do not start the experiment, change traffic, or call a temporary lead a winner. A data specialist should confirm the statistical decision.

learning.assumes: You need to compare two options but may rely on before-and-after data, a few clicks, or personal preference.
learning.outcome: You can check whether an A/B test has a hypothesis, concurrent random assignment, predefined primary and guardrail metrics, and a stopping rule.

modules.title: Randomly assign one visitor pool to A and B for a comparable result

items.title: Answer one main question
items.text: Define the change and primary metric before running the experiment.

items.title: Randomize concurrently with matching definitions
items.text: Use the same eligible population, event definitions, and time window for both groups.

items.title: Predefine the decision and stopping rule
items.text: Set primary and guardrail metrics, sample needs, and stopping conditions before launch.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: An {c:ab-test} uses randomized comparison. A before-and-after report cannot remove other changes over time. A {c:feature-flag} can control exposure, but exposure control alone is not an experiment.
